page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via attached network block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. The lack of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance specifically for memory-bound workloads rather than high-speed local disk I/O or hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make it a viable option for enterprise applications requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of physical hardware. The ecs.r6.4xlarge is suited for workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and medium-scale data processing tasks.
